title: Shared ACIS-history proxy index
scope: Avoid rebuilding the complete source proxy handle index for every linked modeler in one conversion/export operation.
Preserve zero/duplicate handle rejection and per-modeler graph, class, and owner validation.

sourceChange.before: Each modeler graph helper independently reserves and populates a handle-to-proxy map over the full source proxy inventory.
sourceChange.after: The parent collector builds and validates the index once, then passes it by const reference to each modeler graph closure.
sourceChange.effect: Changes repeated index-build work from once per linked modeler to once per conversion/export operation while retaining a single index for the operation and preserving graph output and fail-closed checks.

focusedTests.coverageNote: Generated two-modeler AC1027 history closure plus REGION and multi-record DataStorage projection in ASCII and Binary DXF.
The owning local round-trip control includes duplicate proxy, owner, self-cycle, malformed-edge, and no-publication checks.

validation.diffCheck: passed for dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp, DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md, and this receipt

assessment.planImpact: Closes one demonstrated per-modeler repeated index construction in the 7S.2c ACIS history collection path; the broader audit and external qualification gates remain active.

testsRun: Strict local DWG round-trip target build
method.limitations: The change avoids repeated index construction but does not provide a benchmark, allocator/RSS measurement, whole-process resource bound, or native semantic qualification.
